card.name: Linking words in commerce and pricing text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (on, to, for, of) and trade words in passages about buying, selling, prices, suppliers and markets. The word is usually followed by a commodity or business term.

modes.label: Linking word in trade phrases
modes.description: A preposition after a price, spending or purchase word, just before the thing being bought or sold.
modes.example: US law requires food aid be spent<< on>> buying food at home, instead of where

modes.label: Market-power wording
modes.description: Words in lawsuit or pricing text about cattle supply, price manipulation or monopoly.
modes.example: Tyson's use of<< captive>> supply injured each member of the class.

card.writes: It pushes away consumer and commercial words and slightly favors crime and physics words, so it is hard to read a clear theme.
card.plain: It lights up on small words inside text about prices, suppliers and trade deals.
